It is easier with this note
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should prepare documents, crates, and feeding plans before arrival so check-in runs smoothly and your companion stays calm.

Safety takes priority over speed on every journey. Julian Dubois should confirm the pet is fit for travel, and Blue should remain settled in an approved crate during handling. <<FACT F078>> Place bedding that is clean and secure, and keep food, water, and identity tags ready. 

For cat travel, crate size must be checked before departure. <<FACT F067>> Nikhil Khan should review the carrier fit with the desk, since a proper fit helps protect the animal and the crew alike.

Please bring all required papers to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways for prompt guidance and final review.
